# Renderpeople Eric — source evaluation

Retrieved 22 September 2026 from the publisher's [free collection](https://renderpeople.com/free-3d-people/).
The official FBX bundle contains three nested archives; only **Eric Rigged 001**
was extracted for this single-character study. No other character was imported
or made into a replacement variant.

Exact download URL, archive and extracted-file hashes are in `source-manifest.json`.
Original geometry, textures, skin weights and rig are by **Renderpeople**.
SilverScreen does not claim authorship of that source art.

The publisher's [terms dated 13 December 2024](https://renderpeople.com/general-terms-and-conditions/)
apply to free downloads (2.5), permit rendered imagery and real-time game use
(4.1), and restrict transfer or accessible redistribution of source data
(4.2–4.3). This is a proprietary free asset, **not CC0**. Keep original and
derived source files private; this task does not publish or redistribute them.

The reviewed derivative uses uniform physical scale, one relaxed neutral pose,
one subdivision level, preserved UVs, source normal/gloss detail and URP material
conversion. It has no relationship to the rejected MakeHuman mesh pipeline.

This clothed scan is a quality study, not proof of an extensible modular human
base: complete hidden anatomy, independent garment patterns and a production
expression library are absent. Visual approval must precede decisions about
retopology, separation, sculpting and controlled customization.
